parameters.name: FirewallType
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud firewall. Valid values:
- **VpcFirewall**: virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.
- **InternetFirewall** (default): the Internet border firewall.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description: The rule list. Conditional requirement: when RuleType is set to customize, you must specify at least one of this parameter or AttackApp. If you specify only RuleType without Rules or AttackApp, the API returns ErrorParameters.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
